screen.tablilla.title: Apocalyptic Tablet
screen.tablilla.locked_desc: This strike has not yet been carved into the tablet.
msg.tablilla.busy: A strike is already under way. Use /tablilla stop to end it.
msg.tablilla.terrain_off: Terrain damage: OFF (light and sound only)
msg.tablilla.not_ready: That strike is not available yet.
msg.tablilla.need_tablet: Hold the tablet in your hand.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.plasma.desc: A plasma beam descends from the sky with forking lightning and fuses the crater into obsidian, magma and glass.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.godly.desc: A golden pillar of light with rising halos falls from the sky and turns the crater into gold and quartz.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.blackhole.de: A sphere of darkness with an accretion disk devours the terrain and drags everything in, until it collapses.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.meteor.desc: 72 meteors pound the land round the target, then one the size of a hill hits it: a crater about 125 blocks across.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.mothership.d: A kilometre-long asteroid ship drops in over the target, drills a shaft to bedrock and cuts a molten trench with its beam. Then it blinks away.
laser.tablilla_apocaliptica.downfall.des: Missiles launched from the horizon bring the ship down. It crashes and carves a huge furrow; its engine ruptures and a black hole swallows it whole.
